Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Vintage-Look Square Hanging Wall Mirror, 39.5 Inch Height, Tan and White
Colors: Glass
Materials: glass
A subtly white-washed wood frame gives this mirror a vintage feel, and rows of molding give it substantial depth and texture. Hang it in any bedroom, hallway or living room where you want to add a rustic touch. Subtle white-wash finish and wide molded frame create vintage appeal Glass with solid fir wood frame 31.5"W x 2.5"D x 31.5"H Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware not included.
